title: atoms: .harness/config/atoms.json
description: Tunes the market engine (market/motor.py) that the atoms skill and its preparation hook share. Every key is optional and the file itself is optional; the environment variables ATOMS_MAX_MODS, ATOMS_BUDGET, ATOMS_MIN_CHARS and ATOMS_MIN_TOKENS override the file. The engine ignores unknown keys silently, so this schema rejects them to catch typos; `$`-prefixed keys are comments.

^\\$.description: A comment (for example `$comment`) or `$schema`; ignored by the engine.

maxMods.description: Cap on stacked mods per set. Default: 3. Env override: ATOMS_MAX_MODS.

budget.description: Character budget for the injected block; the tail is trimmed beyond it. Default: 14000. Env override: ATOMS_BUDGET.

minChars.description: Prompts shorter than this mount nothing, unless a directive forces it. Default: 20. Env override: ATOMS_MIN_CHARS.

minTokens.description: Minimum meaningful words for a prompt to mount a set. Default: 3. Env override: ATOMS_MIN_TOKENS.

neverAuto.description: Atom ids (roles or mods) never picked from wording in this project, added to the lexicon's `never_auto`. Still attachable with `@role:` / `@mod:`. Matched case-insensitively. Default: [].

allowAuto.description: Atom ids removed from the lexicon's `never_auto` for this project, so wording can pick them (for example `ds-house`, which is opt-in). Matched case-insensitively. Default: [].

signals.description: Extra project detectors merged over the lexicon's `project_signals` (a key here replaces the lexicon's entry with the same name). Signals only break exact score ties. Default: {}.

package.json.description: Dependency name (or scope prefix) -> tokens added when the session's directory or the project root declares that dependency in dependencies, devDependencies or peerDependencies.

files.description: Path relative to the session's directory or the project root -> tokens added when that path exists.

cards.description: Card-driven roles: a prompt that names a card (a key with one of keyPrefixes, e.g. PROJ-12) or carries one of loopMarkers (an autonomous loop's prompt, whose iteration picks the card) mounts no role from its wording: the card names it, among the roles its board allows (see the backlog skill). The key itself is not scored. Default: off.

^\\$.description: A comment; ignored by the engine.

keyPrefixes.description: Card key prefixes, as in PROJ for PROJ-12. Default: [].

loopMarkers.description: Substrings that mark an autonomous loop's prompt (for example the path of its prompt file). Default: [].

tokens.description: Words fed to the scorer as if the prompt contained them (for example design-system, house, ui).
